hooks.command: node -e "const fs=require('fs');let d='';process.stdin.on('data',c=>d+=c);process.stdin.on('end',()=>{const i=JSON.parse(d);const p=i.tool_input?.file_path;if(p&&fs.existsSync(p)){const c=fs.readFileSync(p,'utf8');const lines=c.split('\n');const matches=[];lines.forEach((l,idx)=>{if(/^\s*print\s*\(/.test(l)&&!/#\s*noqa/.test(l)&&!/logging|logger|debug/.test(l))matches.push((idx+1)+': '+l.trim())});if(matches.length){console.error('[Hook] WARNING: print() found in '+p);matches.slice(0,5).forEach(m=>console.error(m));console.error('[Hook] Consider using logging module instead')}}console.log(d)})"

node -e "const fs=require('fs');let d='';process.stdin.on('data',c=>d+=c);process.stdin.on('end',()=>{const i=JSON.parse(d);const p=i.tool_input?.file_path;if(p&&fs.existsSync(p)){const c=fs.readFileSync(p,'utf8');const patterns=[/['\"]sk-[a-zA-Z0-9]{20,}/,/['\"]password\s*=\s*['\"][^'\"]+['\"]/,/['\"]secret\s*=\s*['\"][^'\"]+['\"]/];for(const pat of patterns){if(pat.test(c)){console.error('[Hook] SECURITY: Possible hardcoded secret in '+p);console.error('[Hook] Use environment variables instead');break}}}console.log(d)})"

PreToolUse.matcher: tool == "Bash" && tool_input.command matches "(flask run|python run\\.py|python -m flask)"
